crossRefs.note: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.

people.name: Jorkeam
people.line: A son or town founded by Raham

people.name: Raham
people.line: Son of Shema and founder of Jorkeam, of Judah

people.name: Rekem
people.line: Son of Hebron, of the tribe of Judah

people.name: Shammai
people.line: Father of Maon, ancestor of Caleb

translations.web: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.
translations.bsb: Shema was the father of Raham the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem was the father of Shammai.
translations.kjv: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.
translations.asv: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem begat Shammai.
